summary_en: ¥65/share total dividend for FY3/27 (¥5 increase from ¥60 prior forecast); mid-term ¥15, year-end ¥50. Policy reset from fixed 30% payout ratio to whichever is higher of 30% payout ratio or 4.0% DOE. Effective FY3/27.
title_en: Notice on Change in Dividend Policy and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
On 29 July 2026, CORE Corporation's board of directors approved a change in dividend policy and a revision upward of the FY3/27 (year ending 31 March 2027) dividend forecast. The company announced an increase to ¥65 per share for the full year, up ¥5 from the prior forecast of ¥60, comprising ¥15 interim and ¥50 year-end.

The policy change shifts the dividend framework from a fixed target of 30% consolidated payout ratio to whichever is higher of (a) 30% consolidated payout ratio or (b) 4.0% DOE (dividend-on-equity based on consolidated shareholders' equity). The company stated the rationale is to implement more stable profit distribution with conscious regard to capital efficiency. This new policy applies from FY3/27 onwards.
